title: Voice classification output (per-marker)
description: Schema for voice_classifier_v1.md output. Consumed by structured-output APIs (OpenAI Structured Outputs, Anthropic tool-use, Mistral JSON mode). Field semantics, decision rules, and few-shot examples live in the companion .md prompt; this file only enforces shape.

classifications.description: One entry per input marker, in input order.

voice_evidence.description: The cue phrase that triggered the call. null when voice = speaker_first_person with no cue, or when uncertain with no isolable cue. char_offsets are computed downstream by the harness via string search; the model only emits the verbatim text.

attributed_to.description: Who is being quoted / reported / attributed-to. null unless voice ∈ {quoted, reported, weasel_attribution} with a named or collective source. person_id resolution is a downstream backfill against the persons registry; the model only emits raw + kind.

rationale_short.description: One sentence in Romanian explaining the voice call, ≤ 200 characters.
